heic2any 0.0.4 (MIT, see heic2any.LICENSE.md)
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/heic2any/v/0.0.4 -> dist/heic2any.min.js (unmodified;
copied from the ecommerce admin's vendor directory, which vendors the same file).

Loaded lazily by lib/upload.js only when a browser cannot decode HEIC/HEIF natively
(everything except Safari). Vendored, not fetched from a CDN. To upgrade: replace the
file and update this note.
